timeout_basis: 33 individually bounded 600-second native commands plus 1800 seconds for builder preflight and before/after inventory; prospective outer ceiling, not a timing claim.
native_scope: The outer receipt records actual builder-child wait facts only. Root must separately archive the true outer tool launch/completion. Missing transport stderr is not empty stderr.
later_binding_obligation: Read actual final builder, its complete preparation and exact B/root/Round2/lifecycle originals; implement direct schema-specific checks and pin every consumed role in a new root-read sealed revision. No caller map, invented paths, hashes, exits or schema may replace those originals.
failure_policy: Preserve all raw evidence. Original timeout/interruption and original native return remain distinct from cleanup return. Never hash streams or seal after abnormal/unclosed builder, incomplete native census, residual groups or missing exact RESULT/nonself manifest. No deletion, retry, output reuse or qa_final mkdir by outer.
observation_scope: Existing P209-style early/late own modules and file-backed maps only; no host-tree expansion/copy, continuous OS/startup trace, child-map or transient-dlopen trace.
